facts: Parties: Merrion Logistics plc (Company) and Whitlock Energy Securities (Underwriter).
Clause 4: the Company grants the Underwriters an option to purchase up to 3,200,000 additional shares (the Over-allotment Option), representing 15% of the 16,000,000 Firm Shares.
Recital C: the Company has 46,450,000 ordinary shares in issue.
Issuer: Merrion Logistics plc. The date of this Prospectus is 3 June 2026.
Use of Proceeds: net proceeds of $120,000,000 will be applied as follows: repayment of the revolving facility $54,000,000; capital expenditure $36,000,000; general corporate purposes $35,000,000.
Capitalisation: 45,200,000 ordinary shares are in issue at the date of this Prospectus.
